text: EX-10.2 3 iiot_ex1002.htm DEBT ACKNOWLEDGMENT AND PREFERRED STOCK EXCHANGE AGREEMENT Exhibit 10.2 Certain personally identifiable information has been omitted from this exhibit pursuant to Item 601(a)(6) of Regulation S-K. ”[***]” indicates where information has been omitted. DEBT ACKNOWLEDGMENT AND PREFERRED STOCK EXCHANGE AGREEMENT This Debt Acknowledgment and Preferred Stock Exchange Agreement (this “ Agreement ”) is entered into as of November 6, 2026 (the “ Execution Date ”), by and between IIOT-OXYS, Inc., a Nevada corporation (the “ Company ”), and Scott Cox, an individual (“ Cox ” or the “ Creditor ”). The Company and the Creditor are each referred to herein as a “Party” and collectively as the “Parties.” RECITALS A. The Company is a reporting company under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “ Exchange Act ”), whose common stock is quoted on the OTCID operated by OTC Markets Group Inc. B. During 2024 and 2025, the Creditor made payments on behalf of the Company to certain third-party service providers, principally for accounting, audit, legal, and other professional services relating to the Company’s operations and its reporting obligations under the Exchange Act (each such payment, as adjusted, an “ Advance ” and, collectively, the “ Advances ”). C. The Company has recorded the Advances as an account payable owed to the Creditor in its accounts payable records, and the Company’s accounts payable aging report supporting its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 identifies the Creditor as a creditor with an outstanding balance of $84,262.65. D. The Advances, the related accounting journal entries, and the amounts thereof are set forth on Exhibit A attached hereto (the “ Schedule of Advances ”). E. The Parties desire to acknowledge the Company’s existing obligation to reimburse the Creditor for the Advances and to exchange such obligation in its entirety for shares of the Company’s Series E Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share and stated value $1,200 per share (the “ Series E Preferred Stock ”), designated pursuant to the Certificate of Designation of Preferences, Rights and Limitations of Series E Convertible Preferred filed with the Nevada Secretary of State on October 30, 2025 (the “ Certificate of Designation ”), which authorizes the issuance of Series E Preferred Stock for cash or in exchange for other securities, rights, or property, on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein. 1 NOW, THEREFORE , in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows: ARTICLE 1. ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF EXISTING OBLIGATION 1.1 Acknowledgment . The Company and the Creditor each acknowledge and agree that: (a) prior to the Execution Date, the Creditor advanced funds or made payments to the third-party service providers identified on the Schedule of Advances on behalf of the Company; (b) the Company received the benefit of such payments; (c) the Company has recorded in its books and records an outstanding obligation to reimburse the Creditor for the Advances (the “ Reimbursement Obligation ”); and (d) subject to the confirmation contemplated by Section 1.3, the aggregate amount of the Reimbursement Obligation outstanding immediately prior to the Closing is Eighty-Four Thousand Two Hundred Sixty-Two and 65/100 Dollars ($84,262.65) (the “ Acknowledged Amount ”). 1.2 Nature of Obligation . The Parties acknowledge and agree that the Reimbursement Obligation is a bona fide obligation of the Company that arose from the Advances prior to the Execution Date, and that this Agreement documents and acknowledges, and does not newly create, the Reimbursement Obligation. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as a representation or acknowledgment that the Advances were made pursuant to any promissory note, loan agreement, or other instrument or agreement, written or oral, or that the Reimbursement Obligation bears interest, has a stated maturity, or is secured by any lien on or security interest in any property of the Company. 1.3 No Additional Amounts; Confirmation of Balance . The Creditor acknowledges and agrees that, other than the Acknowledged Amount, no principal, interest, fees, penalties, expenses, or other amounts are owed by the Company to the Creditor in connection with the Advances or the transactions reflected on the Schedule of Advances. The Schedule of Advances identifies the obligations being acknowledged and exchanged hereunder. Each Party shall confirm in writing at or before the Closing that the Acknowledged Amount remains accurate and outstanding as of the Closing Date, and in the event of any discrepancy, the Parties shall cooperate in good faith to reconcile the Schedule of Advances against the Company’s books and records and the underlying payment records before the Closing. The dates set forth in the Schedule of Advances are the dates of the Company’s accounting journal entries and are not necessarily the dates on which the Creditor made the corresponding payments. 2 ARTICLE 2. EXCHANGE 2.1 Exchange . Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, at the Closing, the Creditor shall exchange, assign, and surrender to the Company the entire Reimbursement Obligation, in the full Acknowledged Amount, and in exchange therefor the Company shall issue to the Creditor 70.218875 shares of Series E Preferred Stock (the “ Exchange Shares ”) (such transaction, the “ Exchange ”). 2.2 Exchange Price . The Exchange Shares shall be issued at an exchange price of $1,200.00 per share of Series E Preferred Stock, which equals the Stated Value (as defined in the Certificate of Designation) per share of Series E Preferred Stock as of the Execution Date (the “ Exchange Price ”). The number of Exchange Shares equals the Acknowledged Amount ($84,262.65) divided by the Exchange Price ($1,200.00), or 70.218875 shares of Series E Preferred Stock. The Parties acknowledge that the Stated Value of the Series E Preferred Stock does not, by itself, establish the fair value of the Exchange Shares. 2.3 Fractional Shares . The Exchange Shares include a fractional share of Series E Preferred Stock, so that the aggregate number of Exchange Shares equals the Acknowledged Amount divided by the Exchange Price without rounding, and the Company shall record the Exchange Shares on its stock ledger to six decimal places. The Creditor acknowledges that the prohibition on fractional shares in Section 5 of the Certificate of Designation applies to shares of Common Stock issuable upon conversion of the Series E Preferred Stock, and that any fractional share of Common Stock otherwise issuable upon conversion of the Exchange Shares shall be treated as provided in the Certificate of Designation. No cash payment shall be made in respect of the Reimbursement Obligation or any fractional Exchange Share. 2.4 Effectiveness . The Exchange shall become effective only upon the valid issuance of the Exchange Shares to the Creditor at the Closing. The execution and delivery of this Agreement shall not, by itself, satisfy, discharge, or extinguish the Reimbursement Obligation. 2.5 Rights of Exchange Shares . The Exchange Shares shall have the rights, preferences, privileges, and limitations set forth in the Certificate of Designation and the Company’s Articles of Incorporation, as amended, and nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to grant the Creditor any right, preference, or privilege in respect of the Exchange Shares beyond those set forth therein. 2.6 Dividend Accrual; Conversion Limitations . Notwithstanding any reference in the Certificate of Designation to the Original Issue Date, the Creditor acknowledges and agrees that dividends on the Exchange Shares shall accrue only from and after the Closing Date, and the Creditor irrevocably waives any right to dividends, Late Fees, or other amounts in respect of the Exchange Shares attributable to any period before the Closing Date. The Creditor further acknowledges that conversion of the Exchange Shares is subject to the Beneficial Ownership Limitation, the leak-out restrictions, and the other limitations set forth in the Certificate of Designation. 3 ARTICLE 3. CLOSING 3.1 Closing . The closing of the Exchange (the “ Closing ”) shall take place remotely by electronic exchange of documents and signatures on such date as the Parties may agree in writing, following satisfaction or waiver of the conditions set forth in Article 6 (the date on which the Closing occurs, the “ Closing Date ”). 3.2 Company Deliveries . At the Closing, the Company shall deliver or cause to be delivered: (a) evidence that the Company, acting as its own transfer agent and registrar for the Series E Preferred Stock, has recorded the issuance of the Exchange Shares in the name of the Creditor on the Company’s stock ledger in book-entry form, bearing the legend set forth in Section 5.2, together with a written statement of the information required by Nevada law to be furnished to holders of uncertificated shares, or such other evidence of issuance as is reasonably appropriate; and (b) a copy of the resolutions of the Board of Directors of the Company (the “ Board ”) approving this Agreement and the issuance of the Exchange Shares. As used in this Agreement, “Transfer Agent” means Issuer Direct, the Company’s transfer agent for the Common Stock, together with any successor transfer agent for the Common Stock. 3.3 Creditor Deliveries . At the Closing, the Creditor shall deliver to the Company: (a) the written confirmation of the Acknowledged Amount contemplated by Section 1.3; (b) the investor questionnaire, in the form provided by the Company, completed and executed by the Creditor (the “ Investor Questionnaire ”); (c) a completed IRS Form W-9; and (d) such other documents as the Company may reasonably request to effect and record the issuance of the Exchange Shares. ARTICLE 4. SATISFACTION, CANCELLATION, AND RELEASE 4.1 Satisfaction . Effective automatically upon the valid issuance of the Exchange Shares to the Creditor at the Closing, and without further action by any Party: (a) the Reimbursement Obligation shall be fully and irrevocably satisfied, discharged, and extinguished; and (b) the Creditor shall have no further right to repayment or reimbursement of the Advances or any portion thereof. 4.2 Limited Release . Effective upon the valid issuance of the Exchange Shares, the Creditor, on behalf of himself and his heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns, hereby irrevocably and unconditionally releases and forever discharges the Company and its subsidiaries, and their respective directors, officers, employees, agents, successors, and assigns (collectively, the “ Released Parties ”), from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, and liabilities, whether known or unknown, for repayment or reimbursement of the Advances or the Reimbursement Obligation, including any claim for interest, penalties, fees, costs, or other amounts asserted in respect thereof (the “ Released Claims ”). The Released Claims do not include, and this Section 4.2 shall not release, (a) any rights or obligations under this Agreement, (b) any rights of the Creditor as a holder of the Exchange Shares, or (c) any claim unrelated to the Advances or the Reimbursement Obligation. 4.3 Evidence of Indebtedness . The Parties acknowledge that no promissory note or other instrument evidencing the Reimbursement Obligation is known to exist. If any note, instrument, invoice, statement, or other document evidencing all or part of the Reimbursement Obligation is subsequently identified, the Creditor shall promptly deliver such document to the Company marked “satisfied” or “canceled,” and any such document shall be deemed satisfied and canceled as of the Closing regardless of whether so delivered. 4.4 Accounting Treatment . The Creditor acknowledges that the Company may adjust its books and records to reflect the extinguishment of the account payable owed to the Creditor and the issuance of the Exchange Shares, and that the Company makes no representation as to the accounting or tax treatment of the Exchange. 4 ARTICLE 5. SECURITIES LAW MATTERS 5.1 Exemption . The Exchange Shares are being offered and issued in reliance upon the exemption from registration provided by Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “ Securities Act ”), and in reliance upon applicable exemptions under state securities laws, based in part on the representations of the Creditor set forth in Article 7 and the information provided by the Creditor in the Investor Questionnaire. 5.2 Restrictive Legend . Each certificate or book-entry notation representing the Exchange Shares shall bear a legend substantially as follows, in addition to any legend required by the Certificate of Designation or applicable state securities laws, and any shares of Common Stock issued upon conversion of the Exchange Shares shall bear such legend unless, at the time of issuance, such shares may be issued without restrictive legend in compliance with the Securities Act (including Rule 144 thereunder), as determined by the Company and its counsel, consistent with the Certificate of Designation: “THE SECURITIES REPRESENTED HEREBY HAVE NOT BEEN REGISTERED UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT OF 1933, AS AMENDED (THE “SECURITIES ACT”), OR THE SECURITIES LAWS OF ANY STATE, AND MAY NOT BE OFFERED, SOLD, PLEDGED, OR OTHERWISE TRANSFERRED EXCEPT PURSUANT TO AN EFFECTIVE REGISTRATION STATEMENT UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT AND APPLICABLE STATE SECURITIES LAWS OR AN AVAILABLE EXEMPTION FROM SUCH REGISTRATION, AND, IF REQUESTED BY THE COMPANY, UPON DELIVERY OF AN OPINION OF COUNSEL REASONABLY SATISFACTORY TO THE COMPANY THAT SUCH REGISTRATION IS NOT REQUIRED.” 5.3 Stop-Transfer Instructions . The Company may make stop-transfer notations on its stock ledger with respect to the Exchange Shares, and may issue stop-transfer instructions to the Transfer Agent with respect to any shares of Common Stock issued upon conversion of the Exchange Shares, in each case consistent with Section 5.2. 5.4 Filings . The Company may make such filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission and state securities regulators as it determines are required in connection with the Exchange, and the Creditor shall cooperate with the Company and provide such information as the Company reasonably requests in connection therewith. ARTICLE 6. CONDITIONS TO CLOSING 6.1 Conditions to Obligations of the Company . The obligation of the Company to consummate the Exchange is subject to the satisfaction, or waiver by the Company in writing, of each of the following conditions: (a) this Agreement shall have been duly executed and delivered by the Creditor; (b) the Board shall have approved this Agreement, the Exchange, and the issuance of the Exchange Shares, and, if the Creditor is an Affiliate (as defined in the Certificate of Designation) of the Company, such approval shall include the express approval of a majority of the disinterested directors of the Company and a determination that the Exchange is on an arm’s-length basis, or the Company shall have obtained the consent of the holders of Series E Preferred Stock required by Section 9 of the Certificate of Designation; (c) the Parties shall have confirmed the Acknowledged Amount in accordance with Section 1.3; (d) the Company shall have instructed the Transfer Agent to reserve the shares of Common Stock issuable upon conversion of the Exchange Shares as contemplated by clause (f); (e) the Company shall have received all consents and waivers required under its agreements with GHS Investments, LLC and any of its affiliates (collectively, “ GHS ”), and all other consents, waivers, and approvals of any third party or governmental authority required in connection with the Exchange, each in form and substance satisfactory to the Company; (f) the Company shall have confirmed that, after giving effect to all shares of Series E Preferred Stock previously issued (including as dividends) or reserved for issuance, the issuance of the Exchange Shares will not cause the number of outstanding shares of Series E Preferred Stock to exceed the 3,000 shares designated under the Certificate of Designation, and that the Company has sufficient authorized, unissued, and unreserved shares of Common Stock to reserve for conversion of the Exchange Shares as required by the Certificate of Designation; (g) the issuance of the Exchange Shares shall comply with the Certificate of Designation, including any limitations on issuance, holders, or ownership set forth therein; (h) the Company shall be satisfied that the issuance of the Exchange Shares is exempt from registration under the Securities Act and applicable state securities laws; (i) the representations and warranties of the Creditor shall be true and correct as of the Execution Date and the Closing Date; and (j) the Creditor shall have made the deliveries set forth in Section 3.3. 5 6.2 Conditions to Obligations of the Creditor . The obligation of the Creditor to consummate the Exchange is subject to the satisfaction, or waiver by the Creditor in writing, of each of the following conditions: (a) the representations and warranties of the Company shall be true and correct in all material respects as of the Execution Date and the Closing Date; and (b) the Company shall have made the deliveries set forth in Section 3.2. 6.3 Termination . If the Closing has not occurred on or before November 13, 2026, either Party may terminate this Agreement by written notice to the other Party, provided that the right to terminate shall not be available to a Party whose breach caused the failure of the Closing to occur. Upon termination, this Agreement shall be of no further force or effect, except Article 9, which shall survive, and the Reimbursement Obligation shall remain outstanding in accordance with its terms as they existed immediately prior to the Execution Date, without prejudice to the acknowledgment set forth in Article 1. ARTICLE 7. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES OF THE CREDITOR The Creditor represents and warrants to the Company, as of the Execution Date and as of the Closing Date, as follows: 7.1 Capacity . The Creditor is an individual with full legal capacity to execute, deliver, and perform this Agreement. This Agreement has been duly executed and delivered by the Creditor and constitutes the legal, valid, and binding obligation of the Creditor, enforceable against him in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, and similar laws affecting creditors’ rights generally and to general principles of equity. 7.2 Ownership of Claim . The Creditor is the sole legal and beneficial owner of the entire Reimbursement Obligation, free and clear of any lien, pledge, security interest, claim, or other encumbrance. The Creditor has not sold, assigned, transferred, pledged, granted any participation in, or otherwise disposed of or encumbered all or any portion of the Reimbursement Obligation or any interest therein. 7.3 No Prior Satisfaction . No portion of the Acknowledged Amount has been repaid, settled, offset, or otherwise satisfied by the Company or any other person. 7.4 No Other Agreements . There is no agreement, arrangement, or understanding, written or oral, between the Creditor and the Company or any of its officers, directors, or affiliates providing for any interest, fee, premium, additional compensation, security, or repayment right in respect of the Advances or the Reimbursement Obligation, other than this Agreement. 7.5 Investment Intent . The Creditor is acquiring the Exchange Shares for his own account, for investment purposes only, and not with a view to, or for offer or sale in connection with, any distribution thereof in violation of the Securities Act or applicable state securities laws. The Creditor confirms each of the acknowledgments in Section 5 of the Investor Questionnaire, including those about investment intent, restricted securities, investment risks, and conversion restrictions, and those acknowledgments are incorporated herein by reference. 6 7.6 Investor Status . The Creditor is an “accredited investor” as defined in Rule 501(a) of Regulation D under the Securities Act, on the basis indicated in the Investor Questionnaire. The Creditor, alone and without a purchaser representative, has such knowledge and experience in financial and business matters, including substantial management experience with private and public companies, that he is capable of evaluating the merits and risks of the Exchange and an investment in the Exchange Shares and of protecting his own interests in connection therewith. The information provided by the Creditor in the Investor Questionnaire is true, correct, and complete. The Creditor acknowledges that the Company is relying on that information and on this Article 7 in determining whether the exemption described in Section 5.1 is available. The Creditor shall promptly notify the Company if any such information ceases to be accurate before the Closing. 7.7 Access to Information . The Creditor has had access to the Company’s filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission and to such other information concerning the Company as he has requested, has received and reviewed this Agreement and the Certificate of Designation, and has had the opportunity to ask questions of and receive answers from the Company regarding the Company, the Series E Preferred Stock, and the Exchange. All such questions have been answered to the Creditor’s satisfaction. No such access or investigation limits the Creditor’s right to rely on the Company’s representations and warranties in Article 8. 7.8 Risks . The Creditor understands that an investment in the Exchange Shares is speculative and involves a high degree of risk, including the risk of loss of the entire investment; that there is no public market for the Series E Preferred Stock and none may develop; that conversion of the Exchange Shares and resale of the underlying Common Stock are limited by the Beneficial Ownership Limitation and leak-out restrictions in the Certificate of Designation; and that he is able to bear the economic risk of holding the Exchange Shares for an indefinite period. 7.9 Restricted Securities . The Creditor understands that the Exchange Shares have not been registered under the Securities Act or any state securities laws, are “restricted securities” within the meaning of Rule 144 under the Securities Act, and may not be resold absent registration or an available exemption; that the availability of Rule 144 is subject to conditions, including the Company’s compliance with its reporting obligations and any limitations applicable to current or former shell companies; and that, except for any piggy-back registration rights expressly set forth in Section 11 of the Certificate of Designation, the Company has no obligation to register the Exchange Shares or the shares of Common Stock issuable upon conversion thereof. 7.10 No Solicitation . The Creditor did not learn of the opportunity to acquire the Exchange Shares through any advertisement, article, notice, or other communication published in any media or broadcast, or through any seminar or meeting to which he was invited by general solicitation. 7.11 Independent Advice . The Creditor has had the opportunity to consult with his own legal, tax, and financial advisors regarding this Agreement and the Exchange. The Creditor acknowledges that counsel to the Company represents only the Company and has not acted as counsel to, or provided legal or tax advice to, the Creditor, and the Creditor is relying solely on his own advisors with respect to the tax consequences of the Exchange. 7 ARTICLE 8. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES OF THE COMPANY The Company represents and warrants to the Creditor, as of the Execution Date and as of the Closing Date, as follows: 8.1 Organization . The Company is a corporation duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of the State of Nevada, with the corporate power and authority to execute, deliver, and perform this Agreement. 8.2 Authorization; Enforceability . Subject to the approval of the Board contemplated by Section 6.1(b), the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and the issuance of the Exchange Shares have been duly authorized by all necessary corporate action of the Company. This Agreement has been duly executed and delivered by the Company and constitutes the legal, valid, and binding obligation of the Company, enforceable against it in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, and similar laws affecting creditors’ rights generally and to general principles of equity. 8.3 Valid Issuance . Upon issuance in accordance with this Agreement and the Certificate of Designation, the Exchange Shares will be duly authorized, validly issued, fully paid, and nonassessable, free of any liens created by the Company, other than restrictions on transfer under this Agreement, the Certificate of Designation, and applicable securities laws. 8.4 No Conflict . Subject to receipt of the consents and waivers described in Section 6.1(e), the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement by the Company will not (a) violate the Company’s Articles of Incorporation, including the Certificate of Designation, or Bylaws, (b) violate any law applicable to the Company, or (c) result in a breach of or default under any material agreement to which the Company is a party. 8.5 No Other Representations . Except as expressly set forth in this Article 8, the Company makes no representation or warranty, express or implied, regarding the Company, the Exchange Shares, or the Exchange, including as to the value of the Exchange Shares or the tax consequences of the Exchange. 8 ARTICLE 9. GENERAL PROVISIONS 9.1 Governing Law; Venue . This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Nevada, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Clark County, Nevada, for any action arising out of or relating to this Agreement; provided that any dispute concerning the rights, preferences, or limitations of the Exchange Shares under the Certificate of Designation shall be resolved in the forum specified in the Certificate of Designation. 9.2 Notices . All notices hereunder shall be in writing and shall be deemed given when delivered personally, one business day after deposit with a nationally recognized overnight courier, or when sent by email with confirmation of transmission, addressed as follows (or to such other address as a Party may designate by notice): if to the Company: IIOT-OXYS, Inc., 705 Cambridge St., Cambridge, MA 02141, Attention: Chief Executive Officer, Email: contact@oxyscorp.com; if to the Creditor: Scott Cox, [***], Email: [***]. 9.3 Entire Agreement . This Agreement, including Exhibit A , constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous understandings, written or oral, with respect thereto. 9.4 Amendments; Waivers . This Agreement may be amended or any provision waived only by a written instrument signed by both Parties (or, in the case of a waiver, by the Party against whom the waiver is to be effective). 9.5 Successors and Assigns . This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the Parties and their respective heirs, successors, and permitted assigns. The Creditor may not assign this Agreement or any rights hereunder, including the Reimbursement Obligation prior to the Closing, without the prior written consent of the Company. 9.6 Severability . If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or unenforceable, such provision shall be enforced to the maximum extent permissible and the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect. 9.7 Further Assurances . Each Party shall execute and deliver such further instruments and take such further actions as may be reasonably requested by the other Party to carry out the intent of this Agreement, including any documents reasonably requested by the Transfer Agent. 9 9.8 Expenses . Each Party shall bear its own costs and expenses, including legal and advisory fees, incurred in connection with this Agreement and the Exchange. 9.9 Survival . The representations, warranties, covenants, and releases contained herein shall survive the Closing. 9.10 Counterparts; Electronic Signatures . This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument. Signatures delivered by email in PDF format or by electronic signature service complying with applicable law shall be deemed original signatures for all purposes. 9.11 Interpretation . Headings are for convenience only and shall not affect interpretation. The words “including” and “includes” shall be deemed followed by “without limitation.” This Agreement shall be construed as if drafted jointly by the Parties. text: EX-10.3 4 iiot_ex1003.htm SERIES C PREFERRED STOCK EXCHANGE AGREEMENT, DATED NOVEMBER 6, 2026 Exhibit 10.3 SERIES C PREFERRED STOCK EXCHANGE AGREEMENT This Series C Preferred Stock Exchange Agreement (this “ Agreement ”) is made and entered into as of November 6, 2026 (the “ Effective Date ”), by and among IIOT-OXYS, Inc., a Nevada corporation (the “ Company ”), Clifford L. Emmons (“ Emmons ”), Vivek Dave (“ Dave ”) and Giro Di Biase (“ Di Biase ”). Emmons, Dave and Di Biase are referred to herein individually as a “Holder” and collectively as the “Holders.” The Company and the Holders are referred to herein individually as a “Party” and collectively as the “Parties.” RECITALS WHEREAS , the Company has previously authorized and issued shares of its Series C Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share and stated value $1,200 per share (the “ Series C Shares ”), the rights, preferences, privileges, restrictions and limitations of which are set forth in the Company’s Certificate of Designation for the Series C Convertible Preferred Stock, as amended (the “ Series C Certificate of Designation ”); WHEREAS , the Company has authorized shares of its Series E Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share and stated value $1,200 per share (the “ Series E Shares ”), the rights, preferences, privileges, restrictions and limitations of which are set forth in the Company’s Certificate of Designation for the Series E Convertible Preferred Stock (the “ Series E Certificate of Designation ”); WHEREAS , the Holders collectively are the record and beneficial owners of all fifty-seven (57) outstanding Series C Shares, and each Holder is the record and beneficial owner of the number of Series C Shares set forth opposite such Holder’s name on Schedule A (with respect to each Holder, such Holder’s “ Surrendered Series C Shares ”), together with all accrued and unpaid dividends, late fees, default charges and related payment rights attributable thereto (with respect to each Holder, such Holder’s “ Associated Rights ”); WHEREAS , the Company and each of the Holders desire to simplify the Company’s preferred-stock capitalization through the voluntary exchange of each Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares and Associated Rights for newly issued Series E Shares (the “ Exchange ”), with the consideration for each Holder determined by reference to an agreed exchange value calculated as of September 30, 2026 (the “ Valuation Cutoff Date ”), which agreed exchange value encompasses both such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares and all of such Holder’s Associated Rights; WHEREAS , each Holder has independently and voluntarily agreed to accept the Series E Shares specified for such Holder on Schedule A as full and final consideration for such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares and Associated Rights, and to waive any additional dividends, compounding, late fees or related charges that otherwise would accrue under the Series C Certificate of Designation after the Valuation Cutoff Date through the Closing Date; WHEREAS , the Board of Directors of the Company has authorized and approved the Exchange and the execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement; and WHEREAS , this Agreement is intended solely to effect the Exchange with respect to the Holders and is not intended to amend generally either the Series C Certificate of Designation or the Series E Certificate of Designation, or to create any rights in addition to those provided by the Series E Certificate of Designation. 1 NOW, THEREFORE , in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows: 1. THE EXCHANGE. 1.1 Exchange Consideration . Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, at the Closing (as defined below), each Holder, severally and not jointly, shall irrevocably surrender, assign, transfer and deliver to the Company all right, title and interest in and to such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares identified on Schedule A and all of such Holder’s Associated Rights, and in exchange therefor the Company shall issue to such Holder the number of Series E Shares set forth opposite such Holder’s name on Schedule A, being such Holder’s Agreed Exchange Value (as defined in Section 1.3) divided by $1,200 (the stated value per Series E Share) (with respect to each Holder, such Holder’s “ Issued Series E Shares ”). Schedule A is incorporated herein by reference. Each Holder’s Issued Series E Shares constitute the entire consideration for the surrender of such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares and the satisfaction of all of such Holder’s Associated Rights, and no Holder shall be entitled to any Series E Shares in addition to those specified for such Holder on Schedule A, whether on account of the number of Surrendered Series C Shares or otherwise. To the extent permitted by the Series E Certificate of Designation, applicable Nevada law and the procedures of the Company’s transfer agent, fractional Series E Shares shall be issued to eight (8) decimal places, rounded to the nearest one-hundred-millionth of a share, as set forth on Schedule A. The Parties acknowledge and agree that such rounding is solely for administrative purposes and does not alter the agreed economic consideration for the Exchange. In the event of any discrepancy between a Holder’s Agreed Exchange Value and the corresponding number of Series E Shares set forth on Schedule A, the Agreed Exchange Value shall control, subject to the foregoing rounding convention. 1.2 Satisfaction and Extinguishment of Rights . The Parties intend that the Exchange with each Holder be consummated at a single coordinated Closing. With respect to each Holder, effective upon, and subject to, the consummation of the Exchange with such Holder and the issuance to such Holder of such Holder’s Issued Series E Shares, (a) such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares shall cease to be outstanding and shall have the status provided under applicable Nevada law and the Series C Certificate of Designation; (b) all accrued and unpaid dividends, late fees, default charges and related payment obligations attributable to such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares, whether arising before or after the Valuation Cutoff Date and through the Closing Date, shall be fully satisfied, discharged and extinguished; and (c) such Holder shall have no continuing claim against the Company for any additional amount attributable to such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares or Associated Rights. No surrender, satisfaction, waiver or release by a Holder under this Agreement shall become effective unless and until such Holder has received such Holder’s Issued Series E Shares. From and after the Closing, the Issued Series E Shares shall carry the rights, preferences, privileges, restrictions and limitations set forth in the Series E Certificate of Designation, and dividends on the Issued Series E Shares shall accrue in accordance therewith from the date of issuance. 2 1.3 Agreed Valuation and Cutoff. The Parties agree that the exchange value attributable to each Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares and Associated Rights, determined as of the Valuation Cutoff Date, is the amount set forth opposite such Holder’s name on Schedule A (with respect to each Holder, such Holder’s “ Agreed Exchange Value ”), and that the aggregate Agreed Exchange Value for all fifty-seven (57) Surrendered Series C Shares is $76,408.00. Each Agreed Exchange Value is the negotiated settlement and exchange value between the Company and the applicable Holder and shall remain fixed regardless of the date on which the Closing occurs. Each Holder, severally and solely as to such Holder, expressly agrees that the consideration specified for such Holder on Schedule A shall not increase, and that no additional Series E Shares, cash or other consideration shall be payable to such Holder, in respect of any dividend accruals, compounding, late fees or related charges that would otherwise arise under the Series C Certificate of Designation after the Valuation Cutoff Date through the Closing Date, all of which such Holder voluntarily waives and settles pursuant to Section 4.10. 2. CLOSING. 2.1 Closing . The closing of the Exchange with all of the Holders (the “ Closing ”) shall take place remotely by the electronic exchange of documents and signatures on November 6, 2026, or such other date as the Parties may agree (the “ Closing Date ”). A Closing after November 6, 2026 shall not alter any Holder’s Agreed Exchange Value or the number of Issued Series E Shares issuable to any Holder. 2.2 Holder Deliveries . At or prior to the Closing, each Holder shall separately deliver to the Company (a) a counterpart signature page to this Agreement, duly executed by such Holder; (b) any stock certificate(s) or other instruments evidencing such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares, duly endorsed for transfer or accompanied by duly executed stock powers (or, in the case of any lost, stolen or destroyed certificate, an affidavit of loss and such indemnity as the Company may reasonably require), or, for Surrendered Series C Shares held in book-entry form, such instructions or documentation as the Company or its transfer agent may reasonably require to effect the transfer; and (c) such other documents as the Company may reasonably request to effect the Exchange with such Holder. 2.3 Company Deliveries . At the Closing, the Company shall (a) issue to each Holder such Holder’s Issued Series E Shares in book-entry form (or, if applicable, by certificate) registered in the name of such Holder; (b) update the Company’s stock ledger and records, and instruct its transfer agent as necessary, to reflect the cancellation of each Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares and the issuance of each Holder’s Issued Series E Shares; and (c) deliver this Agreement, duly executed by the Company. 2.4 Further Assurances . Each Party shall execute and deliver such further instruments and take such further actions as may be reasonably necessary or appropriate to carry out the purposes of this Agreement and to effect the Exchange. 3 3. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES OF THE COMPANY. The Company represents and warrants to each Holder as of the Effective Date and as of the Closing Date that: 3.1 Organization . The Company is a corporation duly incorporated, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the State of Nevada. 3.2 Authority; Authorization . The Company has all requisite corporate power and authority to execute and deliver this Agreement, to perform its obligations hereunder and to consummate the Exchange. The execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement and the consummation of the Exchange have been duly authorized by all necessary corporate action on the part of the Company, including authorization by the Board of Directors of the Company. 3.3 Execution and Enforceability . This Agreement has been duly executed and delivered by the Company and constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the Company, enforceable against the Company in accordance with its terms, except as may be limited by applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium and similar laws affecting creditors’ rights generally and by general principles of equity. 3.4 Authorization and Availability of Series E Shares . The Issued Series E Shares have been duly authorized and, as of the Closing, a sufficient number of authorized and unissued Series E Shares will be available for issuance in the Exchange. 3.5 Valid Issuance . The Issued Series E Shares, when issued pursuant to this Agreement, will be validly issued, fully paid and nonassessable. 4. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES OF THE HOLDER. Each Holder, severally and not jointly, and solely as to such Holder and such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares, Associated Rights and Issued Series E Shares, represents and warrants to the Company as of the Effective Date and as of the Closing Date that (and each reference to “the Holder” in this Section 4 shall be read as a reference to such Holder): 4.1 Ownership and Title . Each Holder is the sole record and beneficial owner of, and has good and valid title to, the exact number of Series C Shares set forth opposite the Holder’s name on Schedule A, which constitute the Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares, free and clear of all liens, claims, encumbrances, security interests and restrictions on transfer (other than restrictions arising under applicable securities laws and the Series C Certificate of Designation), and each Holder has full right and authority to surrender and exchange such Surrendered Series C Shares pursuant to this Agreement. 4.2 No Prior Transfer . Each Holder has not sold, assigned, transferred, pledged or otherwise disposed of, or granted any option or right with respect to, any of the Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares or Associated Rights. 4 4.3 Authority . Each Holder has full right, power, capacity and authority to execute and deliver this Agreement, to perform the Holder’s obligations hereunder and to consummate the Exchange, and this Agreement constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the Holder, enforceable against each Holder in accordance with its terms. 4.4 Investment Intent; Own Account . Each Holder is acquiring the Issued Series E Shares for the Holder’s own account, for investment purposes only, and not with a present view to, or for sale in connection with, any distribution thereof in violation of applicable securities laws. 4.5 Sophistication; Advisers . Each Holder has such knowledge and experience in financial and business matters, or has had access to and relied upon the advice of appropriate independent advisers, such that each Holder is capable of evaluating the merits and risks of the Exchange and the Issued Series E Shares. 4.6 Access to Information . Each Holder has had the opportunity to obtain such information as each Holder deems necessary to evaluate the Exchange and to ask questions of, and receive answers from, the Company concerning the Company and the Issued Series E Shares. 4.7 Economic Risk . Each Holder is able to bear the economic risk of an investment in the Issued Series E Shares, including a complete loss of such investment. 4.8 Transfer Restrictions . Each Holder acknowledges that the Issued Series E Shares are subject to restrictions on transfer under applicable securities laws and the Series E Certificate of Designation. 4.9 Acknowledgment of Differences in Securities . Each Holder understands and acknowledges that the Series C Shares and the Series E Shares are different securities having different rights, preferences, privileges, restrictions and limitations, notwithstanding their equal $1,200 stated values. Each Holder acknowledges that it has received or had access to the Series E Certificate of Designation, has had the opportunity to review it and to consult with its own independent legal, tax and financial advisers, and voluntarily elects to accept the Issued Series E Shares in exchange for the Surrendered Series C Shares. 4.10 Acknowledgment, Waiver and Release. Each Holder (a) accepts the Holder’s Issued Series E Shares, based on the Holder’s Agreed Exchange Value set forth on Schedule A, as the fixed and entire consideration for the Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares and Associated Rights; (b) acknowledges the agreed Valuation Cutoff Date of September 30, 2026, and acknowledges that the Series C Certificate of Designation otherwise provides for continuing accrual and daily compounding of dividends and for late fees on unpaid dividends, and that such amounts would otherwise continue to accrue after the Valuation Cutoff Date; (c) effective upon the consummation of the Exchange with the Holder, expressly and irrevocably waives any right to receive additional consideration for any dividends, compounding, late fees, default charges or related amounts accruing after the Valuation Cutoff Date through the Closing Date; (d) effective upon the consummation of the Exchange with the Holder, releases and discharges the Company from all claims for unpaid dividends, late fees, default charges and related amounts attributable to the Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares through the Closing Date, to the extent satisfied or waived under this Agreement; and (e) confirms that the Holder’s Issued Series E Shares represent full and final satisfaction of the Holder’s rights in respect of the Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares. The foregoing waiver and release is given by each Holder solely on its own behalf, does not waive or release any right of any other Holder, is limited to the Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares and Associated Rights, and does not release any other claim, or any right of each Holder under this Agreement or in respect of the Holder’s Issued Series E Shares. 5 5. SECURITIES LAW MATTERS. 5.1 Section 3(a)(9) . The Parties intend that the issuance of the Issued Series E Shares in the Exchange qualify for the exemption from registration provided by Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “ Securities Act ”), to the extent available. In furtherance thereof, the Company is the issuer of both the Series C Shares and the Series E Shares, the Issued Series E Shares are being issued exclusively to the Holders, as existing security holders of the Company, solely in exchange for their respective Surrendered Series C Shares and Associated Rights, no Holder is paying any cash or other consideration in the Exchange, and no commission or other remuneration has been or will be paid or given, directly or indirectly, to any person for soliciting the Exchange. 5.2 Savings Provision . If the exemption provided by Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act is not available with respect to the Exchange, the Parties intend that the issuance of the Issued Series E Shares rely upon any other exemption from registration available under the Securities Act and applicable state securities laws. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as a representation or warranty that any particular exemption from registration is available, and each Party shall reasonably cooperate to establish the availability of an applicable exemption. 5.3 Restricted Securities; Legends . Each Holder acknowledges that the Issued Series E Shares may constitute “restricted securities” under the Securities Act and may be issued with, or subject to, a restrictive legend or corresponding book-entry notation. The Company makes no representation that the Issued Series E Shares are freely tradeable, and makes no representation as to whether any holding period under Rule 144 under the Securities Act will tack to any prior holding period. The transferability of the Issued Series E Shares shall be determined under applicable securities laws. 6. MISCELLANEOUS. 6.1 Further Assurances . Each Party shall, from time to time after the Closing, execute and deliver such additional documents and take such further actions as may be reasonably requested by any other Party to effectuate the purposes of this Agreement. 6.2 Survival . The representations, warranties, covenants and agreements of the Parties contained in this Agreement shall survive the Closing. 6.3 Notices . All notices and other communications under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed given when delivered personally, sent by nationally recognized overnight courier, or sent by email (with confirmation of transmission), in each case to the address or email of the applicable Party set forth on the signature pages hereto or to such other address as a Party may designate by notice to the other Parties. 6.4 Entire Agreement . This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous agreements and understandings, whether written or oral, relating thereto. 6 6.5 Amendments and Waivers . This Agreement may be amended, modified or waived only by a written instrument signed by the Company and each Holder whose rights or obligations are affected by such amendment, modification or waiver; provided that any amendment, modification or waiver that affects only one Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares, Associated Rights, Agreed Exchange Value or Issued Series E Shares shall require the consent only of the Company and such Holder. A waiver shall be effective only against the Party signing it. No waiver of any provision shall constitute a waiver of any other provision or of the same provision on a subsequent occasion. 6.6 Assignment; Successors . No Party may assign this Agreement or any of its rights or obligations hereunder without the prior written consent of the Company and, in the case of an assignment by the Company, each affected Holder. This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the Parties and their respective successors and permitted assigns. 6.7 Severability . If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect, and the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to replace the invalid provision with a valid provision that most nearly reflects the original intent. 6.8 Counterparts; Electronic Signatures . This Agreement may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Signatures delivered by electronic means (including PDF or electronic signature) shall be deemed original signatures for all purposes. 6.9 Expenses . Except as otherwise expressly provided herein, each Party shall bear its own costs and expenses incurred in connection with the negotiation, execution and performance of this Agreement and the Exchange. 6.10 No Third-Party Beneficiaries . This Agreement is for the sole benefit of the Parties and their permitted successors and assigns, and nothing herein shall confer upon any other person any legal or equitable right, benefit or remedy. 6.11 Governing Law . This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Nevada, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. 6.12 Several Obligations . The representations, warranties, covenants, agreements, waivers and releases of each Holder under this Agreement are several and not joint, are made solely as to such Holder and such Holder’s Surrendered Series C Shares, Associated Rights and Issued Series E Shares, and no Holder shall be liable or responsible for any breach by, or the representations, warranties, covenants, agreements, waivers or releases of, any other Holder. text: EX-10.4 5 iiot_ex1004.htm EXTENSION NO. 8 TO CONVERTIBLE PROMISSORY NOTE Exhibit 10.4 Extension No. 8 TO CONVERTIBLE PROMISSORY NOTE This Extension No. 8 (this “Extension ”), effective as of October 31, 2026 (the “ Effective Date ”), to the Convertible Promissory Note, issued July 29, 2020 (the “ Issuance Date ”), as amended, in the original principal amount of $75,000, is by and between IIOT-OXYS, Inc., a Nevada corporation (the “ Borrower ”), on the one hand, and GHS Investments LLC, a Nevada limited liability company (the “ Holder ”), on the other hand. The Borrower and the Holder will be referred to individually as a “ Party ” and collectively as the “ Parties .” Any capitalized terms not defined in this Extension will have the meaning set forth in the Convertible Promissory Note issued July 29, 2020, as amended, issued to the Holder by the Borrower (the “ Note ”), a copy of which, together with each prior extension thereto, is attached hereto as Exhibit A . RECITALS WHEREAS , on July 29, 2020, the Borrower issued to the Holder the Note in the original principal amount of $75,000 (the “ Principal Amount ”); WHEREAS , on April 29, 2021, the Borrower and the Holder entered into Extension No. 1 to the Convertible Promissory Note extending the maturity date to October 29, 2021; WHEREAS , on November 4, 2021, the Borrower and the Holder entered into Extension No. 2 to the Convertible Promissory Note extending the maturity date to April 29, 2022; WHEREAS , on April 29, 2022, the Borrower and the Holder entered into Extension No. 3 to the Convertible Promissory Note extending the maturity date to April 29, 2023; WHEREAS , on May 1, 2023, the Borrower and the Holder entered into Extension No. 4 to the Convertible Promissory Note extending the maturity date to April 29, 2025; WHEREAS , on May 14, 2025, the Borrower and the Holder entered into Extension No. 5 to the Convertible Promissory Note extending the maturity date to October 29, 2025; WHEREAS , on October 29, 2025, the Borrower and the Holder entered into Extension No. 6 to the Convertible Promissory Note extending the maturity date to April 29, 2026; WHEREAS , on May 21, 2026, the Borrower and the Holder entered into Extension No. 7 to the Convertible Promissory Note extending the maturity date to October 31, 2026; and WHEREAS , the Parties wish to amend the Note to extend the Maturity Date to April 30, 2027 (the “ Maturity Date ”). THEREFORE , in consideration of the foregoing recitals, mutual covenants contained herein, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as set forth below. 1 AGREEMENT 1. Extended Maturity Date . Pursuant to Section 4.3 of the Note, the definition of “Maturity Date” in the Note shall be April 30, 2027. 2. Waiver of Prior Defaults . Upon entering into this Extension, the Holder hereby waives all Events of Default, known or unknown to the Holder, by Borrower prior to the Effective Date. 3. No Other Changes . Except as extended hereby, the Note will continue to be, and will remain, in full force and effect. Except as provided herein, this Extension will not be deemed (i) to be a waiver of, or consent to, or a modification or amendment of, any other term or condition of the Note or (ii) to prejudice any right or rights which the Parties may now have or may have in the future under or in connection with the Note or any of the instruments or agreements referred to therein, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time. 4. Authority; Binding on Successors . The Parties represent that they each have the authority to enter into this Extension. This Extension will be binding on, and will inure to the benefit of, the Parties to it and their respective heirs, legal representatives, successors, and assigns. 5. Governing Law and Venue . This Extension and the rights and duties of the Parties hereto will be construed and determined in accordance with the terms of the Note. 6. Incorporation by Reference . The terms of the Note, except as amended by this Extension, are incorporated herein by reference and will form a part of this Extension as if set forth herein in their entirety. 7. Counterparts; Facsimile Execution . This Extension may be executed in any number of counterparts and all such counterparts taken together will be deemed to constitute one instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart of this Extension by facsimile or email will be equally as effective as delivery of a manually executed counterpart of this Extension. 2 IN WITNESS WHEREOF , each of the undersigned has executed this Extension the respective day and year set forth below: BORROWER: IIOT-OXYS, Inc. Date: November 6, 2026 By /s/ Clifford L. Emmons Clifford L. Emmons, CEO HOLDER: Date: November 6, 2026 By /s/ Sarfraz Hajee Sarfraz Hajee, Member 3 EXHIBIT A Convertible Promissory Note issued July 29, 2020, in the original principal amount of $75,000, together with the following extensions thereto: (i) Extension No. 1, dated April 29, 2021; (ii) Extension No. 2, dated November 4, 2021; (iii) Extension No. 3, dated April 29, 2022; (iv) Extension No. 4, dated May 1, 2023; (v) Extension No. 5, dated May 14, 2025; (vi) Extension No. 6, dated October 29, 2025; and (vii) Extension No. 7, dated May 21, 2026.
